meta.dataset: BSP add-on M&A target screen — Frontline Managed Services & Thomas Scientific
meta.method: Seeded with ZoomInfo find_similar_companies for both platforms (results were dominated by large-cap IT services and life-science majors, so used only for competitor context), then built long-lists from web research (WebSearch, legal-industry directories such as ALA/Legaltech Hub, company websites) and ZoomInfo search_companies by domain for headcount/revenue/IDs. Each candidate was verified by fetching its website or a press/directory page; candidates that could not be retrieved were dropped. Fit scores are analyst judgments on five 1-5 dimensions weighted capability 30%, customer overlap 25%, scale 15%, ownership readiness 15%, geography 15%, scaled to 0-100.
sources_summary: PR Newswire / GlobeNewswire / BusinessWire press releases
ChannelE2E, Consulting.us, Law360 Pulse, LawSites (LawNext), Legal IT Insider
ALA (alanet.org) vendor directory, Legaltech Hub, British Legal IT Forum
Harvey & Company, Berenson, Carlyle, ROI-NJ, Tracxn (Thomas Scientific deal history)
caveats: ZoomInfo revenue figures are modeled estimates and can diverge sharply from reality (e.g., Helm360 $116.5M, Midland $147.4M, ZAGENO possibly GMV); treat as directional only.
ZoomInfo enrich_companies returned 'limit exceeded', so founded year/ownership came from websites where stated; otherwise null.
Ownership 'not disclosed' means no sponsor was found on the retrieved pages — it does not confirm independence.

The session's WebSearch budget ran out mid-screen, and several distributor sites (e.g., Neta Scientific, LabChem, LabRepco, Spectrum Chemical, RPI, EquipNet, Hazmasters, Oakwood Chemical) blocked automated fetches. They were left out for lack of a retrieved source, not because they fit poorly; worth checking by hand.
lat/lon are approximate city centroids (geo_precision 'city') unless marked 'address'; hq_address is given where the company publishes it.

Element Technologies (New Charter Technologies), Cedarlane and LabChem (TCP Analytical) are already inside consolidators; they are listed as competitors, or scored low on ownership_readiness, rather than treated as actionable targets.
Smith + Howard is excluded (BSP exit to TPG Growth, closed Aug 6 2026).
Public strategic comps (Avantor/VWR, Thermo Fisher/Fisher Scientific, Transcat) are not profiled here because no source page was retrieved for them in this run.

Verifier corrections 2026-09-24: fl-06 Affinity Consulting HQ changed from Columbus OH to Largo FL (address given on the ALA listing source; the company site does not state an HQ); fl-22 founded_year set to 1996 (site: supporting Toronto since 1996); ts-24 founded_year set to 1900 (site: name known since 1900); hq_address filled from fetched company pages for fl-01, fl-22, ts-04, ts-05, ts-09, ts-13, ts-23, ts-24. Not confirmed from sources: ZAGENO (ts-17) Cambridge MA HQ and DOT Scientific (ts-21) Burton MI location, because both sites render with JavaScript (business descriptions and DOT's woman-owned status were confirmed). ZAGENO is venture-backed rather than independent.
